items.title: Actual fixed-spectrum first-order reply

source.anchor: S2.E1 literal first-order observation; S4.SS1 Eq11 literal hard family; Remark4.2 same-O affine reply; C4 ordinary derivative-existence context.

items.statement: The actual precision–matrix reply is the genuine Euclidean gradient and determines the centered quadratic value. \nabla f_A(x)=Ax,\qquad f_A(x)=\tfrac12\langle x,Ax\rangle. \(d\in\mathbb N,\ d\ge2,\ \kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge2\). Fix any full real \(O\in O(d)\), allowing either determinant sign, and every \(x\in\mathbb R^d\). For \(i=1,\ldots,d\), set \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+(\kappa-1)\cos\theta_i/2\), and \(A=A_\kappa=O\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)O^\top\). The Lean index \(j\in\mathrm{Fin}(d)\) represents \(i=j.\mathrm{val}+1\). The potential is exactly \(f_A(x)=x^\top Ax/2\), with zero additive constant. The response is exact precision multiplication \(q_A(x)=Ax\), not covariance multiplication \(A^{-1}x\) or the primitive hidden-rotation response \(Ox\). The proof produces actual Fréchet derivative existence at every point, then identifies Lean’s total \(\mathrm{gradient}\). Differentiability, symmetry, admissibility, a gradient certificate and reply correctness are not added assumptions. The private consumer uses the same hidden \(O\) for \(A_2\) and \(A_\kappa\). It reconstructs \(g=(\kappa-1)A_2x-(\kappa-2)x\), then the actual pair \((\langle x,g\rangle/2,g)\). Reference \(2\) is the condition-number parameter. The selected direction has no reciprocal or inverse-reply premise. This is pointwise in the latent matrix; the mathematical parameter \(O\) is not an algorithmic disclosure of the eigenbasis. Random seeds, Haar laws, adaptive transcripts, query budgets and sampling accuracy are outside this statement.

obligations.label: Actual literal fixed-spectrum derivative existence and exact value/gradient reply, with genuine same-O reference precision consumer.

bindings.boundary: This proves actual pointwise fixed-spectrum derivative existence, value/gradient reconstruction and its genuine same-O forward-affine consumer. It does not close C-infinity/Hessian/strong-convexity/smoothness/unique-minimizer claims. It supplies no operational one-query or finite-horizon cap theorem, adaptive/private-seed/transcript/output-law equivalence, Gaussian-target or sampling-TV transport, finite-precision or arithmetic-cost theorem, or expected-cost conversion. Both full main lower bounds, their distinct dimension/condition-number/accuracy ranges, remote acceptance and postmerge purification/Exposition Seal remain separate.
